chunks: And among them is Ahmad ibn Hilal al-Abartai

key_terms.الْعَبْرَتَائِيُّ: al-Abartai (a nisba indicating origin or residence)

ai.seo_question: Who is Ahmad ibn Hilal al-Abartai in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: Ahmad ibn Hilal al-Abartai is identified in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* as one of the four prominent emissaries (al-Nuwwab al-Arba’a) of Imam al-Hasan al-Askari, whose collective condemnation by the Imam serves as a critical theological marker for the onset of the Minor Occultation. This specific designation highlights the transition from direct, personal representation to a period of broader, yet still limited, guidance through appointed deputies.
